other_conditions: NGO must be registered under the Societies Act, Trust Act, Company Act or a similar legislation
NGO must operate as an Old Age Home for senior citizens
NGO must be registered under the Tamil Nadu Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Rules, 2009
benefits_summary: Provides a grant-in-aid of ₹5,60,000 per home (with a ₹1,12,000 contribution from the institution) and offers food, shelter, medical care, and recreational facilities to senior citizens.
